summary: Avoid a synchronous Metro status probe when resolving the iOS Debug bundle URL

replay.detail: Debug bundle URL resolution does not change replay, backfill, or stored data.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: The iOS app config plugin changes Debug builds to construct the Metro bundle URL locally instead of synchronously probing Metro, avoiding the scene-create watchdog when Metro is unreachable. React Native still loads the bundle asynchronously and presents its normal error UI. Release builds and client/server protocols are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or deployment coordination is required for this Debug-only change.

manual.detail: No operator action or data migration is required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new rollback or roll-forward requirements.
